name: Yarn Manufacture Laboratory-I
description: Experiments on fibre testing, that is, length; fineness; fibre bundle and single fibre strength; maturity; trash content; drives and functions of blowroom, carding, drawframe and comber; cleaning efficiency of blowroom and carding machines; draft and machine setting in carding and drawframe; uniformity of card and drawframe sliver; fiber orientation in card and drawframe slivers; effect of draft and doubling on mass variation; drafting wave analysis in drawframe; timing diagram of various motions in comber; short fibre extraction efficiency in comber.
